title: CIA-UAP-006, Sighting Of Unconventional Aircraft
doc_notes: This is a CIA information report detailing a civilian eyewitness account of an unconventional aircraft sighting in the USSR in 1955.

incidents.summary: A US national traveling by train near Baku observed a triangular object with three lights being launched from an airfield at a steep angle.
incidents.quote: a huge searchlight on the field itself, shone on a triangular object on the ground
incidents.size: comparable to a US jet fighter
